reviews.x: I have practically no eyebrows, sparse  and patchy at best and it takes forever to try and draw them on without them looking clownish. Not with this eyebrow pen easy peasy snd it comes with a shaping blade and stencils too . I am ordering another straight away. I dont ever want to be without it again

I just bought this and have to say it works great.  I must have 20 eyebrow products that do not work as stated, but this is great.  Mostly it does not rub off and stays most of the day.  I love it and will keep buying.

reviews.t: Better than most eye brow products!
reviews.x: Really looks natural and able to fill in a few sparse spots. It does take practice but guides are very helpful. Washes off easily. Can start fresh daily.

Let's be honest, these types of pencils are not going to give you the look of microblading. It's not possible because they can not be razor thin enough to do so. That being said, this is still by far my favorite eyebrow pencil to date. I have very little eyebrows left due to hair loss and just overplucking back in the day. This helps me to fill them in nicely. I use a mix of the brown and grey because my hair is a color in-between those two. I used to use wunderbrow, which I also liked, but coul
Love this product on the first try! It came with 3 eyebrow template shapes which I found helpful. After some practice, it should be easy to free hand as well.

reviews.t: This product goes on easily and provides great coverage!
reviews.x: This is my 3rd purchase and really like this eyebrow liner. It looks very natural and really lasts.  I can actually wash the rest of my face and leave my brows on and in the morning, just a touch up! I highly recommend it. By the way, if you are a true brown, I would go with the chestnut as the brown ( #2)  runs reddish brown.

reviews.t: It’s long lasting through out the day.
reviews.x: I love this product it’s pigmented long lasting very easy to work with as you can tell I like my brows really dark but the front I always put it very light so we can have the hair stroke effects and this eyebrow tattoo pen. Made it very easy for me to use. Highly recommended

reviews.t: Ok. Get what you pay for.
reviews.x: Not a lot of liquid comes out. Pen is dry.

reviews.t: Dries wrong color. Basically a marker. No strokes just a fill and go. Ugly
reviews.x: First off i wanna start with i ordered an auburn. Which is what came, but once it dries its like a dark brown and let me be loud and clear it does NOT look okay with my hair color as i thought it would be the gingery color it should have been. Second. This is more a higher quality marker bascially you can not see brush strokes yoha re just painting eyebrows on basically. It stays unless you get it wet and it starts to run. And it all around just looks awful and feels weird all dried and scrunchd

I'm a redhead soo... no eyebrows! I do tint them but I have patchy areas. I used this in the brown color to fill them in, and I must say it works pretty good. The brown is not too dark and kinda has a reddish tint to it. It mimics hair strokes pretty well. I did have to redo it a few times, just to get use to it. But that's just because I've never used one. I like it better than the power or dip because it helps the brows not look so block like.

reviews.t: Stays on well, looks surprisingly good.
reviews.x: Takes a bit of practice, not as much in the container as I'd like or it dries out quick?  Once on it stays until washed off, The little lines look surprisingly natural and eyebrows really make a difference,  Get a certain age and they just seem to go away?  No need to pluck anymore! Well unless you get an awful bright silver one, eek the horror shows up like a beacon screaming "you are old" .  I will buy again

My eyebrows don’t grow in full as I’d want them to, and I’ve been looking for a product to make filling in my eyebrows look natural. This one is the best I’ve found so far! It lasts all day and doesnt smudge once dry. The chestnut color goes on a little reddish, but then dries darker to make my brow color. It claims to be waterproof on the label, but comes off easily in the shower. Still a great product!

I use this pen in-between "real" eyebrow touch ups. Works great for touch ups, but wouldn't use it alone to create eyebrows. After a few uses, the tip accumulates residue and has to be wiped away. The microblading razor is great for removing tiny hairs and dead skin. Don't use the eyebrow forms because I've already had my eyebrows professionally done.

I have had permanent eyebrows for years, but never liked the color.  I've tried all sorts of eyebrow pencils, powders, etc.  This product is easy to use and actually makes my eyebrows look more natural by filling in the grayish parts.  It stays on all day even when I am outside in the heat.  I would definitely recommend this product.

This product is super easy to use,goes on very smooth barley have to use any pressure. I really had to scrub to get it off so thats always a plus,dont want to wipe your forehead and your brows come off. Came with eyebrow stensils if unsure what shape you want and a razar for the little hairs. Overall very pleased with the product

This product is deceiving. It's hard to hold the stencil and draw at the same time. Also, the stencils are smaller than my actual eyebrows, so I'm not sure how this would even work. I did try to use the pen on its own and I do like the way the pen is made, but it's not waterproof and/or long-lasting.

Bought this item on a whim. I wasn't too sure how much I'd like it, but I figured I'd give it a try. I'm glad I did. It was easy to use, and so far has not come off under the Arizona sun. Going for a walk in a few hours, I'll be able to give everyone a better update then. So far though, I'm in love

Bought this item on a whim. I wasn't too sure how much I'd like it, but I figured I'd give it a try. I'm glad I did. It was easy to use, and so far has not come off under the Arizona sun. Going for a walk in a few hours, I'll be able to give everyone a better update then. So far though, I'm in love

The applicator is great. Unfortunately, the color of the product isn't what I was expecting. I'd say its closer to a very light brunette or a very dirty blonde. I managed to get the top (where the applicator pokes through) and the bottom off & let water run through it in order to use the tip.

Looooove this brow pen!!! I wish I'd bought the darker brown but that's okay - I'll get it next time. Very easy to use, lasts a LONG time, and doesn't rub or smudge off until I take it off. Superior makeup product for an extremely reasonable price.

reviews.t: Don’t expect to use it much
reviews.x: It’s easy to use and the stencils help if you suck at filling in your brows like I do. But to me it felt like I was coloring my eyebrows with a crayola marker. I used it twice the third time it was dried out even tho the lid was on.

I’m not the most experienced at filling in and shaping my eyebrows. I gave up the first time I tried applying this to my eyebrows, and switched back to my previous makeup tools as they were easier to manipulate and more precise.

Perfect for people like me who are not very artisitct and have trouble doing eyebrows ! I was able to use the stencils wothbeasw and the the pen helped it to appear very realistic !! Definitely recommend this product

I have been wanting to try this for a long time. I finally decided to take the chance and ordered it. I wish I had done so sooner! It is so easy to use and looks more realistic than a regular brow pencil. Love it!

I tried the pencil the day it arrived. I love it especially that it comes with the eyebrow stencils because I can never get that right. I’m not artistic, I don’t have a steady hand but this was easy to use.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say it looks natural and fills in sparse or patchy brows well.
Many reviewers report it stays on all day and doesn't smudge or rub off easily.
Several reviewers note it takes some practice to use, though the included stencils and shaping blade help.
Some reviewers complain about dryness or not enough liquid in the pen.
A few reviewers say the color dries darker or differently than expected.
